    <k>
      #while(
        Compare(Name("i"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
        While(
          BoolOp("and",
            ( UnaryOp("not", Name("found")),
              Call(
                Name("_is_vowel"),
                Subscript(Name("word"), Name("i"))),
              UnaryOp(
                "not",
                Call(
                  Name("_is_vowel"),
                  Subscript(
                    Name("word"),
                    BinOp("-", Name("i"), Int(1))))),
              UnaryOp(
                "not",
                Call(
                  Name("_is_vowel"),
                  Subscript(
                    Name("word"),
                    BinOp("+", Name("i"), Int(1))))),
              .Exprs)),
          Assign(Name("result"), Subscript(Name("word"), Name("i")))
          Assign(Name("found"), Bool(true)))
        Assign(Name("i"), BinOp("-", Name("i"), Int(1))))
      ~> (Return(Name("result")) .Stmts)
      ~> #endcall
      => str(closestScan(CS, I, R, F))
    </k>
    <env> 1 => 0 </env>
    <scopes>
      ( 0 |-> scope(
          ( "_is_vowel" |-> closureVal(
              ("ch", .ParamNames),
              isVowelBody,

            "get_closest_vowel" |-> closureVal(
              ("word", .ParamNames),
              getClosestBody,
              0) ),

        1 |-> scope(
          ( "word"   |-> str(CS)
            "result" |-> str(R)
            "found"  |-> F
            "i"      |-> I ),
          parent(0))
        -1 |-> BUILTINS )
      =>
      ( 0 |-> scope(
          ( "_is_vowel" |-> closureVal(
              ("ch", .ParamNames),
              isVowelBody,
              0)
            "get_closest_vowel" |-> closureVal(
              ("word", .ParamNames),
              getClosestBody,
              0) ),
          parent(-1))
        -1 |-> BUILTINS )
    </scopes>
    <scopeLoc> 2 => 1 </scopeLoc>
    <heap> .Map </heap>
    <heapLoc> 0 </heapLoc>
    <stack>
      ListItem(frame(.K, 0, 1)) => .List
    </stack>
    <ret> noRet </ret>
    <exc> NoExc </exc>
    <exit-code> 0 </exit-code>
    requires I >=Int 0
     andBool I +Int 1 <Int isLen(CS)

rule isVowelBody =>
    Assign(Name("result"), Bool(false))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("a"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("e"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("i"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("o"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("u"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("A"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("E"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("I"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("O"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("U"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    Return(Name("result"))

rule getClosestLoopBody =>
    While(
      BoolOp("and",
        ( UnaryOp("not", Name("found")),
          Call(
            Name("_is_vowel"),
            Subscript(Name("word"), Name("i"))),
          UnaryOp(
            "not",
            Call(
              Name("_is_vowel"),
              Subscript(
                Name("word"),
                BinOp("-", Name("i"), Int(1))))),
          UnaryOp(
            "not",
            Call(
              Name("_is_vowel"),
              Subscript(
                Name("word"),
                BinOp("+", Name("i"), Int(1))))),
          .Exprs)),
      Assign(Name("result"), Subscript(Name("word"), Name("i")))
      Assign(Name("found"), Bool(true)))
    Assign(Name("i"), BinOp("-", Name("i"), Int(1)))

rule getClosestBody =>
    Assign(Name("result"), Str(""))
    Assign(Name("found"), Bool(false))
    Assign(
      Name("i"),
      BinOp("-", Call(Name("len"), Name("word")), Int(2)))
    While(Compare(Name("i"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))), getClosestLoopBody)
    Return(Name("result"))

rule getClosestProgram =>
    Module(
      FuncDef(
        "_is_vowel",
        Params("ch"),
        isVowelBody)
      FuncDef(
        "get_closest_vowel",
        Params("word"),
        getClosestBody))

rule closestCandidate(CS, I)
    => iCons(intSeqAt(CS, I), .IntSeq)

rule vowelPred(C)
    => C ==Int 97
     orBool C ==Int 101
     orBool C ==Int 105
     orBool C ==Int 111
     orBool C ==Int 117
     orBool C ==Int 65
     orBool C ==Int 69
     orBool C ==Int 73
     orBool C ==Int 79
     orBool C ==Int 85

rule isVowelCode(C)
    => true
    requires vowelPred(C)

rule isVowelCode(C)
    => false
    requires notBool vowelPred(C)

rule closestQualifies(CS, I)
    => isVowelCode(intSeqAt(CS, I))
       andBool notBool isVowelCode(intSeqAt(CS, I -Int 1))
       andBool notBool isVowelCode(intSeqAt(CS, I +Int 1))

rule closestScan(_CS, I, R, _F) => R
    requires I <=Int 0
    [simplification]

rule closestScan(CS, I, R, true)
    => closestScan(CS, I -Int 1, R, true)
    requires I >Int 0
    [simplification]

rule closestScan(CS, I, R, false)
    => closestScan(
         CS,
         I -Int 1,
         closestCandidate(CS, I),
         true)
    requires I >Int 0
     andBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I))
     andBool notBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I -Int 1))
     andBool notBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I +Int 1))
    [simplification]

rule closestScan(CS, I, R, false)
    => closestScan(CS, I -Int 1, R, false)
    requires I >Int 0
     andBool notBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I))
    [simplification]

rule closestScan(CS, I, R, false)
    => closestScan(CS, I -Int 1, R, false)
    requires I >Int 0
     andBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I))
     andBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I -Int 1))
    [simplification]

rule closestScan(CS, I, R, false)
    => closestScan(CS, I -Int 1, R, false)
    requires I >Int 0
     andBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I))
     andBool notBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I -Int 1))
     andBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I +Int 1))
    [simplification]

rule closestVowel(CS)
    => closestScan(CS, isLen(CS) -Int 2, .IntSeq, false)

rule #Ceil(intSeqAt(CS, I)) => #Top
    requires 0 <=Int I
     andBool I <Int isLen(CS)
    [simplification]

rule #Ceil(closestScan(CS, I, R, F)) => #Top
    requires I >=Int 0
     andBool I +Int 1 <Int isLen(CS)
    [simplification]
